companyDescription: AAV gene therapy developer · RGX-121/NAVSUNLI for MPS II now on FDA clinical hold with no near-term resubmission expected — but RGX-202 (Duchenne) already met its Phase III primary endpoint and BLA submission is guided for this quarter, plus a partnered retina program (ABBV-RGX-314) with positive 3-year durability data

summary: REFRESH (prior report Sep 29, 2026). RGX-202's Q3 BLA-submission guidance passed without a confirmation in the sources checked, so the Nov 9 Q3 print is the next dated read. ABBV-RGX-314 pivotal wet AMD topline is guided for Q4 2026, the larger binary. The RGX-121 clinical hold (Aug) remains. Consensus $23.58 (+244%; clears the gate). Written against the core Base optimism bias of +23.7pp (realized 14d P75 +6.6%, P90 +11.7%).
